name: Colorado

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, with a red letter C wrapped around a gold disc, set slightly towards the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Blue is for the sky, white for the snow-capped mountains, gold for the state's mineral wealth and sunshine, and red for the earth.

hook: Colorado is blue-white-blue with a giant red C hugging a gold ball, so the flag spells out its own initial.
trivia: "Colorado" is Spanish for "coloured red", after the reddish rock and river silt of the region.
It was designed by Andrew Carlisle Johnson and adopted in 1911.
